_note: Curated parking lots (source='curated'). Shape: (Omit<ParkingLot, 'id' | 'park_id'> & { park_slug: string })[]. Coordinates are approximate points near each lot/entrance (from OSM parking ways where they exist, otherwise the official entrance address) and are labelled as approximate in notes. ada_spaces is null wherever the park does not publish a count. OSM has no capacity/ADA tags at any of these springs, so this file is the primary parking data.

lots.name: North Entrance lot (Head Spring & Blue Hole swimming)
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($6 per vehicle)
lots.notes: Approximate location near 8294 SW Elim Church Rd. Often reaches capacity on hot summer weekends and holidays, at which time the gate temporarily closes. No roadside waiting - law enforcement issues citations. ADA space count not published.

lots.name: South Entrance lot (Dampier's Landing tubing)
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($6 per vehicle)
lots.notes: OSM parking way 174751914 near 12087 SW US Hwy 27. Tubing only - no swimming from this entrance. Fills early on summer weekends; wheelchair-accessible tram runs to the takeout. No roadside waiting - citations issued.

lots.name: Main lot at Ginnie Spring
lots.fee: Included in per-person admission
lots.notes: OSM parking way 583713771. General parking is available at each spring location (facilities page). ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Day-guest overflow lots
lots.fee: Included in per-person admission
lots.notes: Approximate location near the entrance road. Day guests are directed to overflow lots on busy summer weekends; expect a walk to the springs.

lots.name: Main lot near the spring and lodge
lots.fee: $6 per vehicle May-Sep; free Oct-Mar
lots.notes: Approximate location near 28800 NW 182nd Ave. Spring capacity is 100 people, so the park can close before the lot is full. Swim area closed since Jul 16, 2026. ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Main day-use lot
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($6 per vehicle)
lots.notes: Approximate location near 7450 NE 60th St. On busy weekends the gate closes at capacity and day visitors are not readmitted until the next morning (visitor reports). Lot layout may change with the current renovations. ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Headsprings (swimming) entrance lot
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($5 per vehicle); day-use reservation required
lots.notes: OSM parking way 457781954 near 19158 SW 81st Place Rd. Under renovation Sep 9, 2026 - Feb 4, 2027 with limited parking. When the headsprings reach capacity the park closes and vehicles may not wait in line on adjacent roads. News reports cite roughly 250 vehicles per day (estimate). ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Tubing entrance lot (seasonal)
lots.fee: Included in park entry; tube/shuttle fees extra
lots.notes: Approximate location near 10830 SW 180th Ave Rd. Separate entrance for tubing only - no swimming. Open daily Memorial Day-Labor Day, weekends in spring and September, closed Oct-Mar.

lots.name: Main day-use lot (swim area & concession)
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($6 per vehicle); day-use reservation required
lots.notes: OSM parking way 229078670. Park frequently reaches capacity and may close for several hours; campers and boat-tour guests are still admitted. News reports cite about 232 vehicle slots per day (estimate). ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Second day-use lot (picnic area)
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($6 per vehicle); day-use reservation required
lots.notes: OSM parking way 229078671 (access=yes, surface lot). Approximate role - used once the main lot fills.

lots.name: Main spring lot (picnic area & swim lawn)
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($6 per vehicle, paid online with the reservation)
lots.notes: Approximate location west of the spring lawn, near 1800 Wekiwa Circle. Entry is by day-use reservation only, so the lot rarely overflows but reservations sell out on hot weekends. ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Overflow lot along the park drive
lots.fee: Included in park entry
lots.notes: Approximate location. Grass/overflow parking opened by rangers on peak days; longer walk to the spring.

lots.name: Day-use lot at the spring
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($5 per vehicle for 2-8 people, $4 single-occupant); pay by QR code at the entrance
lots.notes: Approximate location near 8300 N.E. State Road 6, Lee. Official notice: the park closes frequently between 10 a.m. and 3 p.m. on weekends and holidays when it reaches capacity, and may reopen later the same day. Visitors may not park and wait on the roadside or in the entrance area - local law enforcement issues citations. Large RVs, RVs pulling trailers and truck-camper combinations are not recommended (limited turnaround space). ADA space count not published.

lots.name: North entrance day-use lot (spring)
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($5 per vehicle, honor box - correct change required)
lots.notes: Approximate location near 799 N.W. Blue Spring Road, Mayo. Official: paved parking for day visitors in the day-use area, plus two bus/trailer spots; the boat ramp at the south entrance has over-sized parking for six vehicles. No reservations and no published capacity-closure pattern. ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Day-use lot above the spring
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($5 per vehicle, honor box - correct change required)
lots.notes: OSM parking way 203171979 (fee=yes) near 674 N.E. Troy Springs Road, Branford. A long, paved switchback ramp runs from the parking area down to the spring dock; divers often use a wagon to carry gear. Small park with no published capacity-closure pattern. ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Main day-use lot (spring and picnic area)
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($6 per vehicle); $2 per person arriving by boat (honor box on the dock)
lots.notes: Approximate location near 18020 N.W. Highway 19, off US 19/98 at the Suwannee River bridge. First-come, first-served with no reservations and no published capacity-closure pattern. Effective Aug. 20, 2026 the floating dock is under an improvement project. ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Main day-use lot (spring and boardwalk)
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($6 per vehicle)
lots.notes: OSM parking multipolygon 9848435 (paved, capacity=150 per OSM - unverified by the park) near 11650 N.W. 115 St., Chiefland. An 800-ft boardwalk leads from the day-use area to the spring. The waterfront restroom has been closed since Jan. 14, 2026 and no EV charging is allowed in the park. ADA space count not published.

lots.name: Main lot (spring, pancake house and visitor center)
lots.fee: Included in park entry ($6 per vehicle)
lots.notes: OSM parking node 3240587929 near 601 Ponce De Leon Blvd. Official: accessible parking is available near all facilities, with sidewalks and boardwalks to the spring (count of ADA spaces not published). No day-use reservations; visitor reviews report the park reaching capacity on hot weekends. Expect a wait for the Old Sugar Mill Pancake House.

lots.name: Main paid lot at the park entrance
lots.fee: Included in per-person admission ($13 adults, $8 children 6-12)
lots.notes: OSM parking way 1148344196 (paved) at 6131 Commercial Way, US 19 at SR 50. Large paved lot run by concessionaire Guest Services; the official accessibility page lists 10 accessible spaces about 20 yards from the entrance (OSM tags 14). Admission is per person at the gate - once the park reaches capacity no more tickets are sold for the rest of the day, and you may not re-enter while it is full.

lots.name: Main lot inside the entrance gate
lots.fee: $5 per vehicle, $10 per bus (effective Aug. 11, 2026); cash or Visa/MasterCard/Discover with photo ID
lots.notes: Approximate location near the gatehouse at 400 E. Kelly Park Rd, Apopka. Official: 280 vehicles are admitted each morning and the gate closes when the park is full - typically within an hour of opening on a summer day. Once full, the first 50 cars in line get an afternoon parking pass (one per car) for the 1 p.m. re-opening, for about 330 vehicles and 1,350 visitors a day. Check the county web page or the capacity information line (407-254-1906), which are updated when the park is full. Leaving temporarily requires a re-entry stamp from the gatehouse. ADA space count not published.
